policy: Release is blocked by any open P0 or P1 issue. P2 issues require owner, target month, and accepted-risk notes.

issues.title: Invite-only beta still needs broader representative trip coverage beyond current automated fixtures
issues.acceptedRisk: Current release-candidate gates prove the launch fixture matrix, regional generated actuals, Athens public share, multi-itinerary public-share flows, production health, guest accessibility, and production visual review. The prompt contract now enforces 60 representative fixtures across friend groups, couples, families, solo travelers, budget, premium, food, nightlife, outdoors, culture, and six regions. The 25-trip beta-representative generated-actuals evidence is attached, map hydration is exercised before readback, wrong-country fallback pins are rejected, and the prompt-suite cross-check passes with 25 generated actuals. The remaining beta phase is now operationalized by qa/beta-human-review-register.json and npm run qa:beta-review-readiness, which validates a 25-review intake matrix across audience, style, region, device, and journey-surface coverage. qa/beta-human-review-packet-manifest-2026-05-21.json and qa/beta-human-review-packets-2026-05-21/ now provide reviewer-ready assignments for all 25 planned reviews, and qa/beta-human-review-submissions-2026-05-21/ now includes one matching JSON submission template per planned review. qa/beta-human-review-intake-2026-05-21.json validates completed reviewer submission files before explicit import into the register. qa/beta-human-review-progress-2026-05-21.json now tracks completed review count, completed-review coverage, score averages, score thresholds, evidence gaps, and unresolved findings, and launch signoff verifies that the packet manifest, submission templates, progress artifact, and intake artifact match the register. qa/beta-human-review-next-wave-ops-2026-05-21.json, qa/beta-human-review-next-wave-ops-2026-05-21.md, and qa/beta-human-review-next-wave-ops-2026-05-21.csv now expose BETA-WAVE-01 with 5 next-wave operator rows for reviewer outreach while restating that this is not completed review evidence. qa/beta-human-review-all-wave-ops-2026-05-21.json, qa/beta-human-review-all-wave-ops-2026-05-21.md, and qa/beta-human-review-all-wave-ops-2026-05-21.csv now expose 25 all-wave operator rows across all 5 scheduled waves while restating that this is assignment/outreach evidence, not completed review evidence. qa/public-launch-blocker-board-2026-05-21.json, qa/public-launch-blocker-board-2026-05-21.md, and qa/public-launch-blocker-board-2026-05-21.csv now expose 25 beta rows plus 3 production visual-review rows as the remaining public-launch operator queue. qa/launch-operator-today-2026-05-27.json, qa/launch-operator-today-2026-05-27.md, and qa/launch-operator-today-2026-05-27.csv now provide the current daily operator packet with 16 send-packet rows, 6 execution steps, verified message files, and exact sent-record handoff. qa/dispatch-sent-record-template-2026-05-27.csv is the current non-import-ready sent-record starter; the release operator must run QA_DISPATCH_MARK_SENT_RECORD=qa/dispatch-sent-record-template-2026-05-27.csv npm run qa:dispatch-mark-sent to validate real outreach proof and QA_DISPATCH_MARK_SENT_IMPORT=1 QA_DISPATCH_MARK_SENT_RECORD=qa/dispatch-sent-record-template-2026-05-27.csv npm run qa:dispatch-mark-sent only after real sends. qa/public-launch-status-2026-05-21.json now exposes this remaining public-launch blocker as 0/25 completed beta reviews with 25 remaining while allowing beta/release-ops readiness to remain green. Public launch still needs at least 25 completed real or representative human reviews with zero unresolved P0/P1 findings.

issues.title: Production visual-diff review cadence should mature from artifact capture to routine human review
issues.acceptedRisk: Automated visual gates currently fail on overflow, app errors, clipped text, overlap, and selected pixel diffs. Launch signoff now requires a fresh production visual review register that tracks the live production commit and deployment URL, verifies reviewed screenshots exist for every production visual result, confirms required public routes and stable diff routes, and records owner, cadence, next review date, protocol, verdict, and blocking findings. qa/production-visual-review-progress-2026-05-26.json now proves the latest live 53e2aac production visual artifact qa/visual-baseline-production-runtime-current-2026-05-27-53e2aac and summary qa/visual-baseline-production-runtime-current-2026-05-27-53e2aac/summary.json are complete, evidence-backed, deployment-bound to globe-travel-375bgo0gm-rodney-blairs-projects.vercel.app, and not inflating history outside dated review entries after the itinerary map accessibility release. qa/production-visual-review-schedule-2026-05-21.md still verifies scheduled future review dates for 2026-05-28, 2026-06-04, and 2026-06-11 with commands, landing/pricing/login/signup/public-share routes, viewports, diff routes, owners, and 25-screenshot acceptance criteria. qa/production-visual-review-intake-2026-05-21.json and qa/production-visual-review-submissions-2026-05-21/ validate completed visual-review submission files before explicit import into the register. qa/launch-operator-today-2026-05-27.json now carries 1 production visual-review send-packet row for PROD-VISUAL-HISTORY-002 and keeps it tied to qa/production-visual-review-dispatch-outbox-2026-05-26 plus the sent-record workflow. qa/dispatch-sent-record-template-2026-05-27.csv is the current sent-record starter for that request; the operator must run QA_DISPATCH_MARK_SENT_RECORD=qa/dispatch-sent-record-template-2026-05-27.csv npm run qa:dispatch-mark-sent to validate real send proof and QA_DISPATCH_MARK_SENT_IMPORT=1 QA_DISPATCH_MARK_SENT_RECORD=qa/dispatch-sent-record-template-2026-05-27.csv npm run qa:dispatch-mark-sent only after real outreach. qa/public-launch-status-2026-05-21.json now exposes this remaining public-launch blocker as 2/4 distinct visual-review history dates with 2 remaining. Public-launch signoff mode additionally requires four distinct production visual-review history entries with passing evidence. The P2 remains open until this cadence has routine human review history through beta and scale rehearsal.
